The only visual editor I use is Netbeans. Which is nice in many ways, but a bit 'too much' at times.

Vi? No not really.

Neovim: a remake which I think eventually aims for full compatability. Emacs: the other side in the edit wars. Nano, Pico (I think). In a desktop environment you have things like Gedit and Kate. Then there are what I think are browser-based editors: Sublime Text and Atom.

If I couldn't use Vim then I might try Emacs or just fall back to Nano.

Emacs > vim
